title: Al-Bayt Guesthouse | A family welcome on Lake Ram
description: A family-run guesthouse by Lake Ram in Mas’ade. Explore our rooms, shared lounge and garden, and contact Omar and Suleiman to plan your stay.
heading: A little closer to the lake.
sub: Stone, wood and a garden by the water. A family welcome from Omar and Suleiman.
ratingLead: See the dated guest score and read the latest reviews directly on Booking.com.

intro: On the banks of Lake Ram, Al-Bayt brings together stone and wood interiors, garden paths and places to sit outside. Omar and his father Suleiman welcome couples and families to Mas’ade.
filmTitle: A short look at the house
filmLead: A short film about the house, as it is. The film is in Hebrew.

roomsIntro: Four accommodation types, with different layouts. Compare the sleeping arrangements below, then ask us which unit suits your stay.
roomNote: Photos and full facilities for each accommodation type are available through its Booking link. Contact us to confirm the exact unit before booking.
rates: Rates and availability depend on your dates and group size. Send us your dates, number of guests and children’s ages for a quote.

sharedTitle: A shared room to gather in
sharedText: Our stone lounge is a shared space for guests, alongside a communal cooking area. It is separate from the private accommodation units.
noPool: The water beside us is Lake Ram. There is no swimming pool at the property.
breakfastText: Continental breakfast is available. Ask us about the current menu, timing and price, and whether it is included in your chosen rate.
breakfastAlt: A breakfast table with salads, bread and small dishes in the garden
galleryIntro: The garden, lake and shared spaces through the seasons. Interior photographs show the character of the property; layouts vary by unit.

areaText: Enjoy Lake Ram and the landscape around Mas’ade. For trips towards Mount Hermon, Banias or Nimrod Fortress, ask us for suggestions and check current opening and access arrangements.
arrival: Please arrange your arrival time with us in advance. Minimum check-in age: 18.
children: Children of all ages are welcome. A free cot for ages 0–2 can be requested, subject to the selected unit and availability. No extra beds are listed. Guests aged 18 and over count as adults.
house: Pets and parties/events are not allowed. There is no swimming pool.
terms: For Booking.com reservations, check the cancellation and prepayment conditions of your selected option. For direct reservations, ask us to confirm the price, inclusions and cancellation/payment terms before you book.
